study: TH07 0.11 Normal Reimu A Stage 1 matched four-head behavior cloning with native-position auxiliary
roles: Optimize only the first floor(0.8*n) chronological usable Boredperson rows, purged where training [t-4,t+4] touches any sanity [t-4,t+4]. Sanity is the full final contiguous 20 percent. All frozen finals evaluated together once on zylo, a previously used diagnostic author.
optimizer: Adam, constant learning rate, default betas, complete permutation per epoch, final weights only
objectives: Sum of four uniform mean action CE plus arm weight times one spatial CE on the inherited 1x1 player logits over the common visual trunk. Position target is floor([native x,y]/8) in the 48x56 output grid. Decoded position is cell center, native pixel units.
initialization: No new weights. The inherited player convolution is recovered from TorchScript parameters. The deployed actor only consumes camera pixels. Both arms have identical graphs, optimizer, batches and heads. Eval-mode layers throughout.

gate.locator_summary: mean of three held per-seed medians; also report each and the pooled median

scope: One original replay per author. No independent-population or gameplay claim. No gradient, sample filtering, checkpoint selection or threshold fitting on held.
